tara.m: CardinalCare precall Fri 10:30am ET. They want a compact evidence bundle: RBAC snapshots, signed audit export, KMS BYOK proof, vuln triage timeline. Can we assemble?
noah.k: I can do RBAC snapshots + a 30-day diff. Will produce tarball + manifest with checksums.
kevin.s: I'll handle signed audit export. Will salt+hash emails and include signed manifest `signed-by:redwood-svc-key-v4`.
maria.c: Add KMS BYOK proof and rotation history. They use Azure KV; need key wrap/unwrap audit events.
noah.k: We emit KMS ops into audit_events; I'll extract sample events and redact secrets.
kevin.s: Incident response Qs: we commit to initial ack 30m, containment plan 4h, IR package 72h for P1s. Include list of artifacts we provide.
sec-bot: Precall checklist: redact PII, confirm MFA on admin roles, include RBAC alerts (last 90 days), document salt rotation policy.
maria.c: Draft one-pager (scope, artifacts, timelines, contacts) please. Upload prepared artifacts only; demo on request.
noah.k: Uploading RBAC tarball + diff script to secure-share and will post link here by EOD.
kevin.s: I'll upload signed export and sample manifest.
sec-bot: Log precall in customer board.
maria.c: Thanks all. Ping here after uploads. :white_check_mark:
